metadata.description: Plugins from Just, the maker of Just Domain.

plugins.name: just
plugins.description: Find a name and a domain for the business you are building. Just Domain checks which domain names are available and what each costs to register and renew, and gives you a link to register the one you choose on justdomain.ai. It also checks whether anything blocks moving a domain you own elsewhere to Just Domain; support arranges the move by email. Read-only: no order is placed and no payment is taken in the chat; you register and pay on justdomain.ai. No account is needed to search.
